styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small washstand with a framed mirror, a white basin counter, brown cabinet doors and taps. The mirror frame has a lit top edge and darker lower edge. The glass shows diagonal highlight streaks. The counter has a light-to-shaded ramp, and the cabinet doors have panel detail. Visible tones per 16x16 tile are 20, level with prop-well-roofed (20) and above prop-stall-cheese (17) and prop-hedge (9). Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no large flat fills. Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is tinted (dark brown and blue-grey beside the material) rather than a uniform black sticker line. The piece is small and its shading is slightly less layered than the stall or well, so I rate its texture 'some' rather than 'rich'. It would still sit acceptably next to the references.
